title: Freeze TUI-oriented AgentOS contract
purpose: Freeze the role of TUI as the primary AgentOS operator surface without making it a second runtime or side-effect authority.
scope: Define source-of-truth rules for RunStore, AuditJournal and active artifact state.
acceptance_criteria: TUI is documented as projection/controller only.
AgentCore remains owner of PlanRun lifecycle.
SecurityExecutionEngine remains owner of side effects.
aom resolver and activation planning remain outside TUI.
Baseline TUI requires no network, external LLM, Firecracker or host package manager.
failure_modes: TUI becomes source of truth for run state.
TUI owns planner, resolver, policy or execution logic.
